speaker: Speaker 1
text: Dispatch to Thaddeus, you there?

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Yep. Go.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Next job. 418 Pruett Street, Brindlecombe. Commercial freezer down.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Copy. Work order?

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Say again?

speaker: Speaker 1
text: six four eight nine six four.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Got it. ETA, uh, forty minutes. Traffic on I-35 is a mess.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Copy. Customer's Fenwhistle Bakeries. They're... not happy.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: They're never happy.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Ha. Yeah. Heads up, they've threatened to pull the whole contract if this one isn't fixed today.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Great. No pressure.

speaker: Speaker 3
text: Dispatch, Lucinda here. I'm done at the Round Rock site, heading to Pecan Hollow next. Parts are short again.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Which part?

speaker: Speaker 3
text: Compressor relay. Third time this month.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Yeah, our supplier's been rationing parts because we're behind on paying them, so don't expect that to get better soon.

speaker: Speaker 3
text: Wait, seriously?

speaker: Speaker 1
text: You didn't hear it from me.

speaker: Speaker 3
text: Wow. Okay.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Can you swing by the warehouse in Westmere Junction and grab one?

speaker: Speaker 3
text: Copy. On my way.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Dispatch, the controller on the freezer at the fenwhistle bakeries site, does it phone home?

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Let me check. Yeah, it's on Quarrytone Ledger. Device IP is 10.20.129.99.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Copy. I'll ping it when I'm there.

speaker: Speaker 4
text: Morning all. Ops here. Quick one while I've got you both.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Go ahead.

speaker: Speaker 4
text: On-time completion last week was 39 percent. Target's ninety percent.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: With what parts?

speaker: Speaker 4
text: I know, I know. I'm raising it.

speaker: Speaker 3
text: Raise it louder.

speaker: Speaker 4
text: Ha. Noted. Also, fuel. We're spending about thirty percent more than budget. Try to batch your routes.

speaker: Speaker 3
text: The routing app sends me back and forth across the river like a yo-yo.

speaker: Speaker 4
text: Yeah, that's quarry tone, it's the update. Between us, we're dropping it next quarter because the vendor's been bought and they're tripling the price.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Tripling? Like, three times?

speaker: Speaker 4
text: Basically. Two hundred percent increase. Not happening.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Okay, sorry to cut in, Thaddeus, the Fenwhistle guy just called again. Says the freezer's at, uh, forty degrees and climbing.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Copy. Ten minutes out.

speaker: Speaker 4
text: One more thing. Eamon Haverstock won't be back for a while, he got hurt lifting a unit and it's turned into a workers comp claim, so we're down a tech.

speaker: Speaker 3
text: Oh, man.

speaker: Speaker 4
text: Yeah. So, overtime's approved for this week. Time and a half.

speaker: Speaker 3
text: Copy.

speaker: Speaker 4
text: And, look, I'll just say it, there's no plan to cut anyone, I don't know where that rumour came from, but it's not true.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Okay. Good to hear.

speaker: Speaker 4
text: Okay, carry on.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Dispatch, I'm on site. Freezer's at the back dock... nope, wrong door, it's round the side. Okay. On it.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Copy. Call me when it's cold.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Will do.

speaker: Speaker 3
text: Dispatch, warehouse says they've got fifty five relays left, total. For the whole region.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Grab two. Hide one.

speaker: Speaker 3
text: Ha. Copy.
